Stated Claim / Post Context:
‘Home Improvement’ Star Reportedly Arrested After Police-Involved Incident

He was reportedly intoxicated at the time

Actual Article Body:
Photo by Barry King/Liaison, Getty Images

Police arrested “Home Improvement” star Jonathan Taylor Thomas after he allegedly kicked a Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Deputy in the stomach during a traffic stop.

The Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department said the child star was arrested on suspicion of obstruction and public intoxication. They said he was the passenger in a car pulled over on the morning of Sept. 21 in Malibu when the alleged incident unfolded, according to TMZ.

Jonathan Taylor Thomas Allegedly Kicked Sheriff Deputy In Stomach Before Arrest https://t.co/LSvw4pTvCl

Law enforcement said Thomas was inside a vehicle stopped in an intersection and was blocking traffic. Police alleged that Thomas was instructed to remain in the car but failed to comply, and reportedly kicked a deputy in the stomach as the officer attempted to arrest him, according to TMZ. (RELATED: Dolly Parton’s Manager Files Restraining Order Against Star’s Nephew Over Alleged Threats Of Violence)

Jonathan Taylor Thomas

UNDATED FILE PHOTO: Jonathan Taylor Thomas. (Photo by Diane Freed) Getty Images

Police arrested Thomas for obstructing and resisting an officer and processed him at the Malibu/Lost Hills Sheriff’s Station’s jail on Monday. The famous actor was released from police custody Tuesday.

Thomas does not maintain a social media account.

His representatives declined to comment on the matter, according to TMZ.
